description: Scripted traces through dsh's settings describe mirror and configuration forms (the real ui-settings plugin over a scripted settings remote). Every `start` begins a fresh world; `answer` steps answer the oldest pending settings.describe / settings.mutate call (or queue for the next one). `expected` is the state after each step. Inputs: tool/vectors/synth_settings_trace.py.

expectedBy.model: dsh TypeScript settings describe mirror and configuration forms (ui-settings)
realClasses: ui-settings `apply` (client/index.ts): invalidation subscriptions, eager ensure, ConfigForms service
glue: fake ctx.remote (TestRemote double of dsh test-support, `$on` + emit) whose settings.describe/mutate answer from the script
step driver, settle loop and snapshot encoder

steps.name: transport failure of the first read
write answer versus read in flight
refused write while a read is in flight
dispose with a read and a refused write pending
